reviews.text: We couldn’t be happier having chosen Texas Tides as our pool builder! From the initial visit to our pool start up, Justin, Madison and crews made this process so easy, fun and stress-free. We never felt pressured in any way, they truly listened to what we wanted every step of the way. Everyone that came through our backyard was courteous and professional. I could’ve watched the plaster guys work all day, they were amazing! Our pool came out exactly as we wanted, down to the specific water color my husband was hoping for. We highly recommend Texas Tides to anyone considering a pool! You won’t be sorry!!
reviews.author: Mari

reviews.text: Justin and his team were awesome to work with. Justin is honest and trustworthy, and good on his word of expectations and deliverables. He checks in during all phases ensuring the job is done, and is a text away to answer any questions. Waiting for landscaping to be done-then need to update with more completed pics
reviews.author: Heather Hemingway

reviews.text: We couldn't be happier with our experience with Justin and Texas Tides Custom Pools! From the initial consultation, Justin and his team truly listened to our vision and needs. They delivered a stunning pool on time and within our budget, exceeding our expectations in every way. Their hands-on customer service made the entire process smooth and enjoyable. If you're looking for a pool company that is professional, reliable, and dedicated to customer satisfaction, look no further than Texas Tides Custom Pools. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Andy Rittler

reviews.text:
When my wife and I decided to put in a pool, we did a lot of research to find the perfect company for the job. There are plenty of companies that can dig a hole in your backyard, but none can match the attention to detail and exceptional customer service provided by Justin and Madison at Texas Tides.

From day one, Justin and Madison showed genuine care for their customers. Madison worked patiently with us, and her creative and thoughtful design transformed our vision into a stunning reality. Meanwhile, Justin’s attention to detail ensured everything came out perfect. Not only did they bring our dream backyard to life, but they also completed the project on time and within budget. Their dedication and hard work exceeded our expectations in every way.

If you are searching for the best pool builder in DFW, look no further than Texas Tides. Justin and Madison are the epitome of excellence, and we couldn’t be happier with our beautiful new pool!
reviews.author: Ryan Maganzini

reviews.text:
I would give Justin and Madison Nelson with Texas Tides 10 stars(5 for each one of them)! What a dynamic duo to work with on our truly custom pool! Madison saw our vision and Justin made it come to life! They were so patient with us and we never felt pressured like with so many other pool companies we met with that made us feel like we were at a car dealership trying to get an upsell. I’m know they had several other customers but they made us feel like we were their only customer and top priority. They also provided us with the best pricing without having to cut out some extras that we wanted. They were always available when we had questions or wanted to change something. This didn’t end when the pool was finished either, they continue to provide exceptional customer service! Highly recommend 10 out of 10 giving them a call if you are looking to build a pool.
Service: 10
Price: 10
Workmanship: 10
Knowledge: 10
Availability: 10
reviews.author: Misty White

reviews.text:
Our backyard oasis is complete! I can’t say enough GREAT things about Texas Tides Custom Pools!!!!! They took my vision and made it reality .. 💕 This is a true cocktail pool.. 15’x30’; 4-4.5’ deep so every inch is usable for relaxation .. 3’x5’ sheer descents..  custom finishes .. extra abalone shell for that bling in the sunlight.. and..  I mean.. glitter grout?!!! Come on 😍

🌟 They worked with our lender (Lyon) and collaborated with our screen enclosure contractor (Lone Star Patio, Austin, TX) for a seamless build process!
🌟Top notch communication and professionalism
🌟True CUSTOM pool builder!
🌟 Locally owned.. owner is amazing! Fully engaged from start to finish
🌟 Uses the same crews for every build .. and EVERY crew was incredible!!

HIGHLY RECOMMEND for your DFW pool!

💦Pool coping: Gray Mist Flamed Granite .. lightly textured so not slippery, turns to a dark gray when wet
💦Waterline: (NPT Tile) Elements Carbon Deco and Elements Gypsum
💦Sheer Descent: (NPT Tile): Tuxedo Black mosaic with **glitter grout **
💦Pebble: Harbor Majestic
reviews.author: T D

reviews.text: Very happy with Texas Tides, great to work with from start to finish.  Also was able to get a sprinkler guy to fix our sprinkler system after the build was completed since it needed modifications because of the pool.  Awesome finished product.
reviews.author: david pinnell

reviews.text:
I could not recommend Justin and Madison at Texas Tides Custom Pools enough! From the very first conversation, it was clear how much they care about their customers and the quality of their work. They treat every project like it’s their own backyard, making sure every detail is just right. Their knowledge, professionalism, and creativity really set them apart, but what I love most is the heart they put into everything they do.

They don’t just build pools, they create spaces for families and friends to make memories for years to come. It’s rare to find people who are not only this talented but also this genuine, trustworthy, and kind. If you’re looking for a company that will go above and beyond while treating you like family, Texas Tides Custom Pools in Godley, TX is hands down the best choice!
reviews.author: Stephanie Ross

We believe that a swimming pool is not just a luxury, but a place for relaxation, entertainment, and creating memories that last a lifetime. Our Team We are a family-owned and operated custom pool and outdoor spaces builder. Our team is made up of experienced designers, project managers, and technicians who are passionate about creating exceptional swimming pools. We work closely with our clients to understand their unique needs and preferences, and we are committed to delivering high-quality workmanship and exceptional customer service. Our Process Our process begins with a design consultation, where we work with our clients to create a custom 3D pool design that meets their needs and fits their budget and vision.
